evidence.supporting_excerpt: Standard panel-sized (18x24 inch) double-sided copper clad laminate for 2-layer PCB production, featuring 1.6mm FR-4 glass epoxy core with 1oz refined copper on both sides. Essential raw material for electronic assembly. HTS 7410.21.3040 due to double copper cladding on qualifying base material.
evidence.relevance_explanation: Identifies specific HTS classification for FR-4 PCB laminate relevant to US import context.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: The applicable subheading for the bare PCB will be 8534.00.0040, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for “Printed circuits: Plastics impregnated, not flexible type: Having a base wholly of impregnated glass: Other.” The rate of duty will be Free.
evidence.relevance_explanation: Confirms US tariff classification and duty rate for PCBs from China under specific ruling.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Facing higher barriers to the US market, Chinese PCB companies actively explored diversified markets to reduce dependence on any single market.
evidence.relevance_explanation: Indicates tariff pressures affecting US market access for PCB manufacturers.
